rationale: Both Marceli and Ion are product designers working at the intersection of user experience and digital products, with Ion bringing fintech-specific expertise from Ledgy while Marceli brings broader user-centered design experience from Huge Design. This is a natural pairing for cross-pollinating design approaches—Ion's focus on fintech product design complements Marceli's product design background, offering an opportunity to exchange perspectives on how design serves different industries and user bases.
intro_message: Marceli Rogała, meet Ion — you're both product designers focused on crafting user-centered digital experiences, and could swap insights on design across fintech (Ion's domain at Ledgy) and broader product contexts.
